name: NC03 Control Center
productIntent: Replace the stock NC03 Web UI with a modern, coherent and easier administration experience.
Preserve or improve verified stock Web UI functional coverage instead of becoming a read-only dashboard.
Perform settings changes on the real modem through a local trusted bridge.
Operate local-first/PWA and remain maintainable across future firmware/profile changes.
nonNegotiableConstraints: Do not invent modem endpoints, request fields, response meanings or rollback behavior.
Do not send modem password, session, cookie or raw private HAR data to cloud services.
Do not expose current Wi-Fi PSK merely to populate the replacement UI.
Every state-changing operation requires verified mapping, post-condition evidence and recovery behavior.
Frontend never talks directly to modem production endpoints; modem traffic belongs to Local Bridge/adapters.
Application Management owns neither modem credential/session nor modem command authority.
Production release remains a separate explicit gate.
